summary: Members with [trim] local = true exchange the claim IDs they retired, by the claim-range walk, and each records the ones it lacked, so no member re-admits a claim another member deleted. Off by default

schema.detail: New local tables retired_range_pending and retired_range_import, two triggers on retired_claim_ids, and namespace 1 rows in claim_range_digests. A paced background fold imports the existing retired claim IDs once. The six ledger triggers on checkpoint_claims and checkpoint_envelopes are replaced by _v2 versions that write only on an ordinary member; a member with [trim] local writes its ledger as it deletes, so a cut that records and stops retires nothing.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. No claim family is trimmed locally yet.

compatibility.detail: Optional wire fields claim_ranges.retired, claim_range_query.retired and the local comparison's retired. Only members with [trim] local send or read them; older builds and ordinary members ignore them and are compared as before.

downtime.detail: None. The retired fold runs in the background after the retained one.

manual.detail: No manual step. Nothing changes unless a member opts in.

recovery.detail: Remove the setting and restart: the member stops sending, reading and learning retired IDs. What it already learned stays in its ledger, unread while the setting is off.
